title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
We are looking for an HR Specialist to join our team. Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the recruitment process, including sourcing, interviewing, and hiring candidates.
- Oversee employee onboarding and orientation programs.
- Handle employee relations and resolve workplace issues.
- Administer compensation and benefit plans.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or related field.
- Proven experience as an HR Specialist or similar role.
- Strong understanding of labor laws and HR best practices.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
